label: 主要用途
Primary uses
value: 穿行、停留、文化参观、活动

label: 空间类型
Spatial type
value: 铁路上盖坡地＋覆盖公共通廊
Sloped rail deck + covered civic passage

label: 服务对象
Users
value: BOTH · 城市文化与社区活动
BOTH · urban culture and community events

label: 所在城市人口
City population
scope: 2025-06-30；City of Melbourne LGA，ABS估计常住人口；大墨尔本另为5,435,590人。
30 Jun 2025; City of Melbourne LGA estimated residents (ABS); Greater Melbourne separately has 5,435,590.

label: 公布广场面积
Published plaza area
scope: Karres en Brands设计资料中的广场面积；运营方现行Main Square场租区域另为5,000 m²。
Plaza area in the landscape designer’s account; current Main Square hire area is separately 5,000 m².

label: 公布活动容量
Published event capacity
scope: 现行Main Square场地页面公布容量；实际活动配置和审批可能更低。
Current Main Square venue listing; actual event layouts and approvals may be lower.
metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

label: 广场年到访量
Annual square visitation
scope: 2025–26财年，运营方年报，printed p26；按其Visitors口径，不宣称为去重人数。
FY2025–26 operator report, printed p26; reported “Visitors”, not established as unique individuals.
metrics.measurement: operator reported visitors; uniqueness not specified

label: 年度活动数
Annual events
scope: 2025–26年报列示；其中37项社区与文化活动，支持114个社区组织。
FY2025–26 report; 37 community/cultural events and 114 community organisations supported.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: 铁路上盖创造连续公共地面，向东整体抬升约6米。
A rail deck creates civic ground with an approximately 6 m eastward rise.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 火车、电车与步行连接CBD及河岸，是高可达的文化节点。
Rail, tram and walking connect CBD and river in a highly accessible cultural node.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: Yarra河形成背景；2025年车库屋顶Test Garden增加植物景观，不能当作2002原广场绿化。
Yarra provides context; the 2025 car-park-roof Test Garden adds planting and is not original 2002 plaza greenery.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 餐饮、酒吧和文化零售沿建筑边缘分布，与免费公共活动并存。
Dining, bars and cultural retail line buildings alongside free public programming.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: Atrium覆盖空间和Labyrinth被动环境系统补充室外使用；不宣称露天广场全年舒适。
Atrium cover and Labyrinth passive conditioning complement outdoor use; year-round outdoor comfort is not claimed.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类并存，兼有公共集会。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist, including civic assemblies.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 普通日自由到访与社区课程，节庆／比赛日形成舞台、屏幕和临时围合。
Ordinary visits and community classes shift to stages, screens and temporary enclosures on celebration and sport days.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: Main Square公布10,000人容量；2025–26年到访1,190万以上、389场活动，口径分别保留。
Main Square lists 10,000 capacity; FY2025–26 reports 11.9m+ visitors and 389 events, with scopes kept separate.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 场地页列65 m² Digital Façade、音响及听力辅助；另有Labyrinth与环境监测系统。
Venue lists a 65 m² Digital Façade, sound and hearing support, alongside Labyrinth and environmental monitoring.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 2025–26支持114个社区组织；同时承接都市文化参观与游客，不能只写成旅游景点。
114 community organisations supported in FY2025–26, alongside cultural visitors and tourists; more than a tourism attraction.

title: 基础设施上的公共地面
Civic ground over infrastructure
text: 通过铁路上盖与坡地，把原本分隔的城市关系重新连接。
Deck and slope reconnect urban relationships separated by rail.

title: 室内外互补
Indoor/outdoor complement
text: Atrium为露天广场补充覆盖空间与文化入口。
Atrium supplements the outdoor plaza with cover and cultural entrances.

title: 文化与数字活动平台
Cultural and digital platform
text: 文化机构、数字屏幕与全年活动支持社区和游客共同使用。
Institutions, screen and year-round programming support both communities and visitors.

title: Federation Square
Federation Square
lede: 铁路上方的一片公共地面，把车站、文化机构、室内通廊与城市活动连接起来。
A civic ground over rail connects the station, cultural institutions, covered passage and city events.

label: 运营方：5,000 m²场租区域与容量
Operator: 5,000 m² hire area and capacity

title: 位置：车站、CBD与河岸之间
Location: between station, CBD and river
lede: City of Melbourne LGA有194,481居民（2025年6月）；它服务的大墨尔本都市区为543.6万人。
City of Melbourne LGA had 194,481 residents in June 2025; the wider Greater Melbourne catchment had 5.436 million.

title: 公共交通
Public transport
text: Flinders Street Station与广场隔街相望，周边电车衔接CBD；位于免费电车区。
Flinders Street Station lies across the street, with trams serving the CBD; the site is within the Free Tram Zone.

title: 最后一段步行
The final walk
text: 通过街口、公共坡地与Atrium联系文化机构和Yarra河。
Crossings, public slope and Atrium connect cultural institutions and the Yarra.

title: 城市角色
Civic role
text: 兼具文化目的地、社区活动场地和城市穿行节点。
Combines cultural destination, community event venue and urban passage.

label: 运营方：公共交通与到达
Operator: transit and arrival

title: 历史：把基础设施变成公共地面
History: infrastructure becomes civic ground
lede: 它的关键创新是建造新的公共地面，再将文化建筑与室内公共空间组织在一起。
Its key move is a new civic ground, organised together with cultural buildings and covered public space.

text: LAB与Bates Smart赢得竞赛，Karres en Brands参与公共空间设计。
LAB and Bates Smart won the competition, with Karres en Brands on public space.
建筑项目完成；景观设计方档案另列2004年Construction字段。
Architectural project completed; the landscape archive separately lists 2004 in its Construction field.

title: 2019以后
2019 onward
text: 列入州遗产登记，建筑与公共空间作为整体持续运营。
State heritage listing recognises an ensemble that continues to operate as civic and cultural space.

title: 同一比例，看三种城市肌理
One scale, three urban fabrics
lede: 相同图幅显示：这里是CBD网格、车站与河流之间的一片人工公共地面。
The common frame reveals artificial civic ground between CBD grid, station and river.

text: 三案均为600 × 600米，北向上、横纵同尺度；矢量图按300毫米宽输出时为1:2500。网页缩放请读图形比例尺。
All three frames cover 600 × 600 m, north up with identical axis scale. Native SVG at 300 mm width is 1:2500; use the graphic bar on screens.

title: 平面：空间如何组织
Plan: how the place is organised
lede: 原始组合平面保留文化功能、公共通行与室内外层级的关系。
The original composite plan retains programme, circulation and indoor/outdoor level relationships.

text: 组合平面将Plaza、Atrium、ACMI、NGV及公共通行组织在不同层级上。它是一组相互连接的空间，不是中央空地加外围建筑的简单拼接。
The composite plan organises Plaza, Atrium, ACMI, NGV and public circulation across levels: an interconnected ensemble rather than a vacant centre with separate objects around it.

label: LAB项目档案：原始组合平面
LAB project archive: original composite plan

title: 剖面：从西向东抬升约6米
Section: an approximately 6 m eastward rise
lede: 约6米高差有文字依据；下面直接展示能够辨认坡地和平台的原始剖面。
The approximately 6 m rise is documented; the original sections below make slope and deck legible.

text: 遗产文件明确记载：广场从Swanston Street向东逐渐抬升约6米。坡面把抵达、观看与停留放在连续地面上；图中铁路位于人工平台之下。
The heritage determination records an approximately six-metre rise eastward from Swanston Street. The slope combines arrival, viewing and staying; rail lies below the artificial deck.
向河岸的剖面显示另一组高差：文化建筑、平台与Yarra河岸的联系。两图分别阅读，不将约6米写成每条路线的坡度或无障碍保证。

The riverward section shows another level relationship between cultural buildings, deck and Yarra frontage. Read the two cuts separately; six metres is not the gradient or an accessibility guarantee of every route.

label: 遗产决定：Description第03段，约6米整体抬升
Heritage determination: Description paragraph 03, approximately 6 m rise
设计团队发布的真实剖面
Actual designer-published sections

title: 连接：抵达、穿行与停留
Connections: arrival, passage and staying
lede: 车站提供到达，文化机构提供目的，公共地面与通廊提供穿行和停留。
The station brings arrival, cultural institutions provide destinations, and public ground and passage enable movement and staying.

title: 抵达
Arrival
text: 车站与电车把城市使用者带到广场边缘。
Station and trams bring city users to the edge.

title: 穿行
Passage
text: 坡地、通廊与街口把CBD和河岸串联。
Slope, passage and crossings connect CBD and river.

title: 停留
Staying
text: 文化入口、边缘座位和活动设施提供不同停留目的。
Cultural entries, seating edges and event infrastructure create different reasons to stay.
车站、街道与河岸在同一片公共地面相接，Atrium补充有遮蔽的通行与停留空间。
Station, streets and river meet across shared civic ground, with Atrium providing covered passage and staying space.

label: 运营方：到达与公共交通
Operator: arrival and public transport

title: 边界：建筑与公共地面
Edges: buildings meet civic ground
lede: 多栋文化建筑形成非连续但可识别的边界，公共地面把这些界面联成整体。
Several cultural buildings form distinct edges, joined into an ensemble by civic ground.

text: 石材、金属与玻璃形成不同透明程度；入口、外摆和覆盖通廊比表皮图案更直接影响人们如何使用建筑边缘。
Stone, metal and glass provide different transparency, while entries, terraces and covered passage shape edge use more directly than cladding patterns alone.

title: 环境：景观、气候与科技
Environment: landscape, climate and technology
lede: 墨尔本气候多变；Atrium补充室外广场的遮蔽，数字屏幕与被动环境系统支持日常运营。
Melbourne’s variable conditions make Atrium cover valuable beside the outdoor plaza; digital screens and passive systems support its operation.

title: 景观
Landscape
text: 河岸与较新的Test Garden补充以硬质地面为主的场地；花园于2025年开放。
River frontage and the newer Test Garden complement the paved precinct; the garden opened in 2025.

title: 天气与气候
Weather and climate
text: 温带、天气多变。旧市中心站1月／7月平均最高气温25.9／13.5°C（1855—2014），不代表广场微气候；Atrium提供覆盖条件。
Temperate and variable. The former central station records Jan/Jul mean maxima of 25.9/13.5°C (1855–2014), not plaza microclimate; Atrium provides cover.

title: 科技
Technology
text: 65 m² Digital Façade用于公共内容与活动，配套声学、供电与听力辅助。
A 65 m² Digital Façade supports public content and events with sound, power and hearing support.

label: BoM：墨尔本Regional Office历史气候统计
BoM: Melbourne Regional Office historical climate statistics

title: 平日：人们怎样使用这里
Ordinary days: how people use the place
lede: 普通日是坐靠、过境、文化参观与餐饮并存的地面；社区活动不是只有旅游旺季才出现。
Ordinary days mix sitting, through movement, cultural visits and dining; community programming extends beyond tourism peaks.
